sloka: श्रुत्वा दधिमुखस्येदं सुग्रीवस्तु प्रहृष्य च ।वनपालं पुनर्वाक्यं सुग्रीवः प्रत्यभाषत ।। ५.६३.२६ ।।।।
transliteration: śrutvā dadhimukhasyedaṁ sugrīvastu prahṛṣya ca ।vanapālaṁ punarvākyaṁ sugrīvaḥ pratyabhāṣata ।। 5.63.26 ।।।।

translations.english: Beautifulnecked Sugriva heard Dadhimukha, the protector of the garden, felt very glad and replied:
